app.name: Workforce
app.description: People, attendance and payroll, run from a face recognition kiosk

common.failed: That did not go through, try again
common.failedHint: The network may have dropped, or the server is busy. Try once more.
common.showingOfAtLeast: Showing {shown, number} of more than {total, number}

login.lead: Your attendance, requests and payslips in one place.
login.title: Sign in

overview.title: Overview
overview.contractsHint: A fixed term left to lapse becomes indefinite by law.
overview.probationHint: Probation that ends undecided becomes a permanent hire.
overview.daysLeft: {count, plural, =0 {today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
overview.absentLead: People with a shift, no punch yet, and no approved leave or trip.
overview.absentShownOf: Showing the first {shown, number} by code, of {total, number}.
overview.absentNone: Nobody is absent without leave today.
overview.leaveLead: People an approved leave request covers today.
overview.exceptionsHint: A shift today and no punch, a late one, or only one. Open a row for that person's punches.

employees.title: Employees
employees.assignLead: The kiosk asks this person for a face sample the next time they stand in front of it. A retake keeps the old sample in use until the new one is taken
employees.assignNone: No kiosk has been approved yet
employees.emptyHint: Nobody in the directory yet. Add the first person to start.
employees.importDry: Dry run: {rows, number} rows, {created, number} to create, {updated, number} to update.
employees.importFaults: {n} faults left — fix the file and pick it again.
employees.departmentsFailed: The department list did not load, so that picker is empty.
employees.consentLead: Decree 13/2023 treats facial features as sensitive data, so consent is recorded on its own rather than folded into the contract.
employees.consentMissing: No consent in force. Without one this person cannot be assigned to a kiosk.
employees.consentWithdrawHint: To punch by face again they need a new consent and a fresh capture on each kiosk.
employees.contractEndHint: Leave empty for an indefinite contract.
employees.payInsuranceHint: Contributions are charged on this figure, not on gross pay.
employees.raiseLead: Preview before writing. Each person gets a new pay row; the old one stays.
employees.raiseEitherHint: One or the other; typing in one clears the other.
employees.raiseWouldWrite: Would write {count, number} new pay rows
employees.sectionFilingLead: The D02-LT insurance filing reads exactly these boxes; an empty one is an empty column.
employees.sectionBankLead: The period's payment file reads these two; left empty, this person's line in it is blank.
employees.bankElsewhere: Bank details change only through a profile-change request, so every change is approved and leaves a trail.
employees.managerHint: People in the same department come first; type a code or a name to find anyone else.
employees.sectionHireLead: With a hire date the system also drafts the contract, records pay and leave and opens the onboarding list; left empty, there is only the record, with no contract or pay.
employees.hireStartHint: Their first day. Leave is earned from it.
employees.insuranceSalaryHint: Many employers set this below base pay.
employees.hireSkipped: The record is written, but taking them on did not finish
employees.personalEmailLocked: Change the personal email through a profile change request, so the old address gets a notice.
employees.hireDateHint: Seniority and severance count from this day.
employees.legalEntityHint: The D02-LT filing and payroll read this; the department list below follows it.
employees.directoryLead: Everyone within your reach. Click a row to open the record.
employees.noMatchHint: Try fewer filters, or search by employee code.
employees.createLead: Once saved, the record opens for the kiosk and the face consent; with a hire date and an email, the account invitation goes out at once.
employees.hireSkippedLead: The record is in the directory, but the contract, pay, leave balances and onboarding checklist were not set up. Retrying does not create a second record.
employees.contractsEmptyHint: Add the first contract; probation and contract ends then show on the directory as they near.
employees.contractEndLead: The {kind} contract {number}, starting {from}, closes for good. To carry on, add a new contract.
employees.payEmptyHint: Add a first pay record so payroll can run for this person.
employees.payAddLead: A new record takes its own effective date; earlier ones stay as they are.
employees.consentWithdrawn: {count, plural, =0 {Consent withdrawn} one {Consent withdrawn, face erased on # kiosk} other {Consent withdrawn, face erased on # kiosks}}
employees.consentWithdrawLead: {name}'s face templates are erased on every kiosk at once and cannot be restored.
employees.leaveEmptyHint: Balances are set up at hiring, or when a leave type applies to this person.
employees.notFoundHint: The link may be wrong, or this person is outside what you can see.
employees.importLead: A dry run first: the whole file is read, faults are reported line by line, and nothing is written. A known code updates that person; a new code adds one.
employees.importFormat_entity: The legal entity code. Leave empty when the company has only one.
employees.importFormat_department: An active department code within that entity, and a job title code.
employees.importFormat_manager: The manager's employee code, already here or on another line. An empty cell means no manager.
employees.importFormat_money: Digits only, no separators. Written only for someone with no pay yet; later changes go through the bulk raise.
employees.importFormat_kept: Written for new people only. For someone already here they change only through a profile change request.
employees.importPayKept: {count, plural, one {# line gives pay for someone who already has it: its pay columns are skipped.} other {# lines give pay for people who already have it: their pay columns are skipped.}}
employees.loginNeedsEmail: The record has no personal email, so no account can open. Add one through a profile change request.
employees.loginLockedHint: Unlock it on the Accounts page.
employees.loginLeftHint: This person has left, so the account cannot open again.
employees.loginOpened: Account opened and setup link sent
employees.skippedTitle: {count, plural, one {Onboarded, with # step left undone} other {Onboarded, with # steps left undone}}
employees.skipped_NO_PAY_GIVEN: No pay yet: add it on the Pay tab before the next payroll.
employees.skipped_PAY_EXISTS: A pay record from the start date already existed and was kept.
employees.skipped_CONTRACT_EXISTS: A contract starting that day already existed and was kept.
employees.skipped_NO_CHECKLIST_TEMPLATE_OR_ALREADY: No onboarding checklist: no template matches the job title and department, or one was already open. Add a template on the Onboarding page.
employees.skipped_NO_EMAIL: No account yet because the record has no personal email. Add one through a profile change, then use Open an account on the right.
employees.skipped_EMAIL_TAKEN: No account yet because this email already belongs to another account. Check the address.
employees.skipped_LOGIN_EXISTS: This person already has a sign-in account.
employees.personalEmailWhy: Left empty, the record still saves, but no account can open and no payslip can be sent.
employees.legalEntityMissing: Pick the legal entity that employs this person
employees.jobTitlesEmpty: No job titles yet. Add them on the Job titles page.
employees.sectionWhoLead: Code and name are enough to save; without a manager, nobody can approve this person's leave.
employees.sectionReachLead: The account invitation and payslips go to the personal email, so without one this person cannot sign in.
employees.departmentsEmpty: No departments yet. Add them on the Org chart page.
employees.pickNoMatchHint: Try the employee code, or fewer letters.
employees.pickNobodyHint: Add people on the Directory page, then pick again.
employees.pickMore: Showing the first few of {total} people; type a code or a name to search.
employees.offboardNowLead: That last day is today or already past, so the record closes now: the login stops at once and the face is erased from every kiosk.
employees.offboardLaterLead: {name} keeps working until the end of {day}; the login and the kiosks keep working. The record closes early on {next}: the login is then locked and the face erased from every kiosk. Until then you can still change or cancel it.
employees.offboardScheduled: Scheduled: {name} works until the end of {day}
employees.offboardLeftoverAhead: Leaving {day}, with loose ends to settle before then
employees.leavingLead: The record closes by itself early on {next}: the login is then locked and the face erased from every kiosk.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.lead: Punches rolled up per person over the chosen range; open a person to see each one. The untrusted-clock column counts records the kiosk itself flagged as an unsynced clock.
attendance.historyEmpty: This person has no punches yet
attendance.rollupLead: Each person's punches for the month; click a row to see every punch.
attendance.unsyncedHint: A clock-off punch is one the kiosk flagged as taken before its clock synced, so its time cannot be trusted.
attendance.exported: Exported {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
attendance.noMatch: Nobody by that name punched this month
attendance.noMatchHint: Try part of another name, or another month.
attendance.personLead: Every punch in the month, newest first.
attendance.personMonthEmpty: No punches by this person this month
attendance.showLate: Only people who came in late

devices.title: Devices
devices.claimLabel: Claim code on the kiosk screen
devices.otaLead: The kiosk fetches the new release, checks its sha256 and restarts; one wrong byte and it stays on what it runs.
devices.otaNone: No release has been published yet
devices.revokeWarn: The kiosk stops recording attendance and has to register again from scratch. Templates already on it stay there until it takes an erase.
devices.releasesLead: CI publishes firmware whenever PROJECT_VER goes up; the training machine publishes models once it packs them. Press Update and the kiosk fetches the new release and restarts itself.
devices.releasesEmpty: No release yet. Raise PROJECT_VER in firmware/CMakeLists.txt and push to main, and CI publishes one.
devices.releaseBehind: {count, plural, =0 {Every kiosk runs this release} one {# kiosk runs something older} other {# kiosks run something older}}
devices.releaseUpdating: {count, plural, one {# kiosk updating} other {# kiosks updating}}
devices.releaseUpdateAllAsk: Offer {target} {version} to {count, number} kiosks? Each fetches it straight away and restarts; punches made meanwhile are still recorded.
devices.releaseUpdateAllDone: Offered to {offered} kiosks{failed, plural, =0 {} other {; # could not be offered}}{busy, plural, =0 {} other {; # skipped while still updating}}.
devices.otaCurrent: The kiosk runs the newest release.
devices.otaBusy: The kiosk is downloading {version} and will restart itself, usually within 1–2 minutes; it shows offline meanwhile, which is expected. {seconds} s so far.
devices.otaStalled: {version} was offered at {at} and the kiosk has not taken it, perhaps because it was offline then. Press Offer again.
devices.otaInterrupted: The kiosk restarted without reaching {version} (power lost mid-download, or the new release failed and rolled back). Press Update to try again.
devices.otaExpired: The offer of {version} expired before the kiosk fetched it. Press Update to offer it again.
devices.leadShort: The attendance kiosks. Click a row to open one; a new machine waits for the code on its own screen.
devices.approveLead: Type the 6-digit code on the kiosk's screen. Only somebody standing at the machine can see it.
devices.noMatchHint: Clear a filter or search by id.
devices.emptyHint: A new kiosk registers itself on first boot and shows up here to approve.
devices.feedEmpty: Nothing has happened since this page opened
devices.claimHint: Enter all {digits} digits the kiosk shows

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.name: Shift
shifts.noneAssigned: Nobody is on this shift yet.
shifts.graceHint: Arriving inside this window does not count as late.
shifts.pageLead: Start, end and grace of each shift. A retired shift stays readable because past assignments still point at it.
shifts.emptyHint: Add a shift to assign people and measure lateness and overtime.
shifts.rosterLead: Hours {hours}. People assigned work to these hours from the start date.
shifts.validToHint: Leave empty if there is no end date.
shifts.unassignLead: {name} is taken off {shift}, including the past days of this assignment.
shifts.unassignHint: The next timesheet rebuild no longer uses this shift's hours for them.
shifts.retireLead: {name} can no longer be assigned. Existing assignments stay and remain readable; you can restore it later.
shifts.whoManyHint: Pick people one after another; everyone chosen shows below and joins in one go.
shifts.assignMany: Put {count, number} people on the shift
shifts.assignedSkipped: {count, number} people were already on it from that date and were skipped.
shifts.rosterSearchHint: Find someone on the shift by code or name

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Six months of attendance and pay cost, the month's insurance changes, and the files the insurance office asks for.
reports.insuranceLead: Who started, who stopped and whose contribution base moved in {month}.
reports.d02Lead: The workforce on one date, for the D02-LT filing.
reports.rollUpLead: Precomputes the first page of Punches for the whole company for {month}, so that page opens fast. Asking twice queues one run.
reports.rollUpQueuedHint: The result lands when it finishes.
reports.unpaidRule: Unpaid leave of {days} days or more in a month is reported as a decrease.
reports.noEntity: No legal entity to report for yet
reports.noneMatch: Nobody in this list matches the search.
reports.attLead: Six months to {month}, everyone you can see. Open a month for its timesheet.
reports.payLead: The last six periods to {month} for {entity}. Open one for its detail.
reports.payNone: No pay period up to this month
reports.filesLead: Files for the insurance office, and precomputing figures so pages open fast.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageLead: Changing the language changes the address too, so a link you send carries the language with it
settings.provisionLead: Every active employee with a personal email and no account is emailed a link to set their own password. Anyone with people reporting to them starts as a manager.
settings.provisionNone: Nobody is waiting. An employee with no personal email on file cannot be given one.
settings.provisionOnce: Each person gets an email with a link to set their own password.
settings.themeLead: Follows the system by default; a manual choice stays on this device.
settings.provisionWaiting: {count, number} people still have no login. Run it again to carry on.
settings.passwordLead: Changing it signs out every device that is signed in, this one included.
settings.lead: Your language, appearance, notifications and account.
settings.provisionDone: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody was waiting for a login} one {Invitation sent to # person} other {Invitations sent to # people}}

requests.title: Requests
requests.waitingToSend: {count, number} request(s) waiting to send. They go out on their own once there is a signal.
requests.deskLead: Every request in the branch you cover, all kinds and all states. What waits on you to decide sits in Approvals.
requests.gone: No such request, or it falls outside what you may see.
requests.backwards: The end date cannot fall before the start.
requests.approvalsLead: Everything waiting for your answer, grouped by kind. Decide right here.
requests.nothingWaitingHint: New items show up here as soon as someone sends one.
requests.rejectedOf: {name, select, none {Turned down} other {Turned down {name}'s request}}
requests.issuedTo: {name, select, none {Letter issued} other {Issued the letter to {name}}}
requests.paidTo: {name, select, none {Advance recorded as paid} other {Recorded the advance paid to {name}}}
requests.reasonNeeded: A reason is needed to turn it down
requests.registerNoMatchHint: Change the kind or state to see more.
requests.registerEmpty: No requests in your scope yet
requests.newLead: The request reaches the approver at once; you get a notification when it is decided.
requests.queued: No signal — the request is kept on this device and sent once you are back online
requests.mineLead: Leave, overtime, attendance fixes, trips, remote work and pay advances — everything you have filed, newest first.
requests.mineEmptyHint: Leave, overtime and attendance fixes all start from New request.
requests.withdrawLead: The {kind} request ({span}) becomes withdrawn and the approver no longer sees it. To ask again, file a new request.
requests.balancesEmpty: No leave type has been granted to you yet.
requests.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting in this queue
requests.teamOffNone: Nobody in the team is off on these dates.
requests.bulkRejectTitle: Turn down the {count, number} chosen requests?
requests.bulkApproveLead: Each one is approved as if on its own: leave comes off the balance and the sender is told. Your own requests and ones somebody else already decided are skipped.
requests.bulkRejectLead: The same reason goes to each sender. Your own requests and ones somebody else already decided are skipped.
requests.payLead: The next payroll deducts it by itself. Once recorded it cannot be undone.
requests.inboxSearch: Search by the sender's code or name
requests.noteReadable: The sender can read this note.
requests.decidedOn: Decided on {date}{who, select, none {} other { by {who}}}
requests.registerSearch: Search by the sender's code, name or reason
requests.exported: Saved the register under the filters shown
requests.fixDayHint: Only a day that has ended; today cannot be corrected yet.
requests.fixSeen: The kiosk saw a first punch at {first} and a last at {last}.
requests.fixLooking: Looking at what the kiosk saw that day…
requests.fixNone: The kiosk saw nothing that day, so both the time in and the time out are needed.
requests.fixMissed: Which punch is missing or wrong
requests.fixMissedBOTH: Both the time in and the time out
requests.timesBackwards: The end has to come after the start.
requests.splitByYear: It crosses into the new year, so each year pays for its own days:
requests.workingDaysOnly: Working days only: Saturdays, Sundays and holidays are not counted.
requests.noLeaveTypesLead: HR has not declared any leave type, so leave cannot be requested yet. Let HR know.
requests.noLeaveTypesDeskLead: Nobody can request leave until at least one leave type exists.
requests.unpaidNoBalance: Unpaid leave takes nothing from any balance.
requests.calendarDaysAll: Every calendar day counts, weekends and holidays included.

me.title: My page
me.dependentsLead: Register here; the deduction starts once HR accepts it. The start month is the first month counted.
me.noProfile: This account is not attached to an employee record
me.dependentAdded: Declaration sent; HR will review it
me.dependentsEmptyHint: A child, spouse or parent you support lowers your tax once HR approves.
me.noPayslipHint: It appears here once payroll issues your first period.
me.teamAllIn: Everyone is in and nobody is off today.
me.attLead: Each day of the month: shift, first and last punch, late or missing. Tap a day to see its punches.
me.attNoPunches: The kiosks saw no punch of yours that day.
me.punchesFailed: Could not load punches, tap to retry
me.leaveUsed: {taken, number} taken · {pending, number} waiting · {whole, number} for the year
me.payslipDays: {count, plural, one {# day worked} other {# days worked}}

payroll.title: Payslip
payroll.lead: One row per component, earnings and deductions apart.
payroll.emptyHint: Create a run and press Run to produce payslips.
payroll.advanceLead: Approve, then pay; the next payroll run recovers it.
payroll.settlementLead: This run pays what leaving costs. It sits beside the monthly payslip rather than replacing it.
payroll.settlementEmptyHint: A settlement run covers only people whose leave date falls inside the period.
payroll.delivered: {count, plural, one {# payslip} other {# payslips}} queued to send
payroll.bonusLead: A bonus is somebody's decision, not a derivation, so it is entered here before the run.
payroll.bonusLoaded: {count, plural, one {# amount} other {# amounts}} loaded into the bonus run
payroll.taxYearLead: Added back up from the payslips already issued.
payroll.taxYearEmpty: No payslips in this year yet.
payroll.deliverWarn: A payslip goes to every person in this period. Mail that has gone cannot be recalled.
payroll.advanceDropLead: The {amount} advance request becomes withdrawn and nobody will decide it. To ask again, file a new one.
payroll.advanceEmptyHint: Need part of your pay early? File a request; the next payroll deducts it.
payroll.advanceAmountHint: Amount in dong, in steps of 1,000.
payroll.myLead: Pick a period to see every line, the change from the last period, and raise a dispute if something is wrong.
payroll.myEmptyHint: Your payslips appear here once payroll issues your first period.
payroll.periodsLead: One period a month: run, check, lock, pay, then send payslips. Click a row to open the period.
payroll.openPeriodLead: Pick the month to pay. A month has one period only.
payroll.payDateHint: Can be left empty and set later.
payroll.stepsTitle: The five steps of a period
payroll.periodsEmptyHint: Open this month's period to start paying.
payroll.periodMissing: This pay period was not found
payroll.periodMissingHint: The link may be old. Open the list of pay periods and pick again.
payroll.stepRunNone: Create the monthly run with New run.
payroll.stepRunEach: Press Run on the monthly run; when it is done, move on to checking.
payroll.stepCheckOpen: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing left open.} one {# kind of item still open, see Check before locking.} other {# kinds of item still open, see Check before locking.}}
payroll.periodLeadOpen: Run, check, then lock. Once locked, late data goes to the next period.
payroll.periodLeadLocked: Locked. Pay from the bank file, then mark the period paid.
payroll.periodLeadPaid: Paid. Send the payslips if they have not gone out.
payroll.runsEmptyHint: Create the monthly run and press Run to produce payslips.
payroll.checklistClearHint: Every request, correction and pay record of the period is settled.
payroll.newRunLead: A run works out payslips for {period}.
payroll.runREGULARHint: Everyone's monthly pay, from the timesheet.
payroll.runBONUSHint: Bonus amounts typed per person, taxed on top.
payroll.runFINAL_SETTLEMENTHint: Severance and offsets for people who left in the period.
payroll.lockWarn: Locking cannot be undone. The payslips of {period} become final and late data goes to the next period.
payroll.lockOpenItems: {count, plural, one {# kind of item is} other {# kinds of item are}} still open:
payroll.payWarn: Records that {period} has been paid out. This cannot be undone.
payroll.payNote: Mark it only once the bank has made the transfer from the bank file.
payroll.deliverNote: Only payslips not yet sent go out; nobody gets one twice.
payroll.bonusInRun: {count, plural, one {# amount} other {# amounts}} loaded
payroll.bonusAmountHint: People added get this; change it per row.
payroll.settlementSaved: {count, plural, one {# settlement amount} other {# settlement amounts}} saved
payroll.periodLeadDone: Paid, and the payslips have gone out.
payroll.slipsExported: Payslips exported for the current filter
payroll.totalsOpenHint: Counted over each person's newest finished regular run, the payslips a lock would issue.
payroll.totalsIssuedHint: Counted over the payslips this period issued.
payroll.slipsNoneHint: Run a regular calculation; its drafts show here once it finishes.

policy.copyLead: Copied from the version in force. Change only what actually changes, then set a new effective date.
policy.title: Pay policy
policy.leadShort: Deductions, contribution rates and the tax table, by effective date.
policy.versionRule: A change is a new version with a later effective date, never an edit, so a payslip already issued still recomputes to the figure it showed.
policy.emptyHint: Declare the first version: the deductions, rates and tax table in force.
policy.blankLead: Fill in the figures in force and the date they apply from.
policy.bandsRule: Each band's ceiling is above the one before; only the last band leaves it empty.
policy.problemTitle: This version cannot be saved yet
policy.problemDate: Pick the date it takes effect.
policy.problemFields: {count, plural, one {# field is} other {# fields are}} empty or negative.
policy.problemBands: Tax bands must rise by ceiling, each with a rate, and only the last may leave its ceiling empty.
policy.fieldMissing: Enter a number of 0 or more

timesheet.title: Timesheet
timesheet.emptyHint: Rebuild the month to fold punches into attendance days.
timesheet.monthLead: Each person's attendance for the month; click a row to see each day.
timesheet.totalsAll: Summed over all {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} with attendance this month.
timesheet.rebuildLead: Folds punches into attendance days again for the whole month shown. Today and days still ahead are skipped; days corrected by hand are kept.
timesheet.rebuildSettling: Rebuilding {month}; the table updates itself when it is done.
timesheet.rebuildQueuedHint: The table updates itself when it finishes.
timesheet.emptyMonth: No attendance days for this month yet
timesheet.daysLead: {code} · {worked, number} worked, {absent, number} absent, {leave, number} on leave
timesheet.daysEmpty: No attendance days for this person this month

timesheet.rebuildDone: The timesheet is rebuilt and the new figures are showing
timesheet.rebuildFailed: Rebuilding the timesheet did not finish; try again in a few minutes
timesheet.exported: Timesheet exported for the current filter
timesheet.exportFilter: Export to Excel with this filter
timesheet.correctClockInvalid: Enter clock-in and clock-out; clock-out must come after clock-in.
timesheet.correctReasonMissing: Give a reason; a correction without one cannot back a payslip.

notices.pushTurnedOn: Push notifications on for this device
notices.pushTurnedOff: Push notifications off for this device

org.treeLead: The headcount covers the whole branch, not the department on its own.
org.name: Name
org.reorgLead: Preview before applying. The preview says which managers lose sight of whom.
org.reorgManagerHint: Leave empty to keep their manager.
org.reorgRequests: {count, number} pending requests move to the new approver
org.reorgLosing: {count, number} managers lose sight of part of their branch
org.head: {count, number} people
org.emptyHint: Add the top-level department first, then the ones under it.
org.peopleOfLead: People working directly in this department; sub-departments are listed on their own.
org.peopleNoneHint: People in sub-departments are not counted here.
org.headHint: Who heads this department. It does not route requests: those follow each person's manager.
org.searchHint: Find a department by name, code or head
org.editLead: Name, code, head and cost centre. To place it under another branch, use Move.
org.addLead: A new department belongs to the same legal entity as its parent.
org.parentHint: Leave empty to place it at the top.
org.moveLead: Everything below it moves too. It cannot go under itself, its own sub-departments or another legal entity.
org.retireLead: Only possible once nobody works in it and no sub-department is in use. Past records stay as they are, and it can be restored later.

holidays.title: Public holidays
holidays.lead: The holiday calendar decides which days count as paid working days. Without a row here, a holiday counts as absent and is docked.
holidays.name: Name
holidays.empty: No holidays entered for this year
holidays.noneOfKind: No holidays of this kind this year
holidays.emptyHint: Without it, that day counts as absent and is docked.
holidays.addLead: The day becomes a holiday for everyone.
holidays.removeLead: {date} becomes an ordinary working day for everyone, and that day's attendance is rebuilt.
holidays.removeHint: Anyone who did not work that day is counted absent and docked.
holidays.editLead: {date}. To move it, remove it and add the new date.

setPassword.lead: Set a password to open your account
setPassword.noToken: This address carries no code. Open the link from your email.
setPassword.doneHint: Your account is open. Sign in with the password you just chose.
setPassword.title: Set your password

forgot.lead: Enter your address. If it has an account, a link to set a new password goes to it.
forgot.sentHint: If that address has an account, the link is on its way. Look in the spam folder too.
forgot.title: Forgot password

changePassword.lead: Change the password for the account you are signed in as
changePassword.warn: Changing it signs out every device that is signed in, this one included.
changePassword.doneHint: Every device has been signed out. Sign in again with the password you just chose.
changePassword.title: Change password

myShifts.title: My shifts
myShifts.lead: This month and the ones ahead, so you can plan around them.
myShifts.emptyHint: The roster appears here once HR sets your shifts.

certificates.title: Letters
certificates.lead: Ask for a letter of employment or of income; HR approves and numbers it.
certificates.purposeHint: For example: a bank loan, a visa, a course
certificates.askLead: HR reviews it and issues a serial number; an issued letter opens ready to print.
certificates.emptyHint: Need a letter of employment or income for a bank or a visa? Ask for it here.
certificates.stillWaiting: HR has not decided this request yet. Once issued, the letter opens here ready to print.

profile.title: Change a personal detail
profile.lead: A change is a request; HR reads it before the record moves.
profile.bankWarning: Changing where your pay goes warns the address on file, and leaves a locked period alone.
profile.askLead: HR reviews it before it goes on your record. A locked payroll period is not changed.
profile.asked: Request sent; HR will review it
profile.emptyHint: Changing your email, phone, pay account or ID numbers starts here.
profile.emailWarning: Changing your contact email sends a notice to the address on file.
profile.cancelLead: The request to change {field} closes and your record stays as it is. To change it, send a new request.

disputes.title: Dispute a payslip
disputes.lead: It becomes a record, with a deadline to answer and an outcome kept.
disputes.claim: Which figure is wrong, and why
disputes.claimHint: For example: four hours of overtime are missing
disputes.answerHint: Say what was checked against what
disputes.amountHint: Leave empty if nothing is owed; an amount rides the next payroll
disputes.empty: No dispute on this payslip yet
disputes.paid: An adjustment for the next period has been made
disputes.raiseLead: A dispute about the {period} payslip. Payroll answers before the deadline and the outcome is kept.
disputes.withdrawLead: The dispute about {line} closes and will not be answered. To ask again, raise a new one.

documents.title: Documents and files
documents.lead: Publish versioned wording, and see who is short of a paper.
documents.myLead: The newest wording of everything that applies to you. A signature binds to the version you read.
documents.noneHint: Add one, then publish its first version.
documents.publishWarning: Publishing asks everybody to sign again. A published version is never edited.
documents.gapsLead: Working people short of a required paper, or holding an expired one.
documents.noGaps: Nobody is short of a paper
documents.noGapsHint: Every working person has the required papers on file.
documents.receiveLead: The original lives in a cabinet; this is only the receipt.
documents.expiryHint: Expiry follows from the paper type, not from a field.
documents.typesLead: Adding a type changes who counts as short of one, with no row to edit.
documents.typesEmpty: No types declared, so nobody counts as missing anything.
documents.gapsClearHint: Every required paper is in and still valid.
documents.addLead: Register the document first; its wording goes into the first version right after.
documents.publishLead: Version {version}. Everyone it applies to will have to sign for it.
documents.summaryHint: Shown to readers before the full text.
documents.readersNoneHint: Its department or job title has nobody working in it.
documents.validMonthsHint: Leave blank if it never expires.
documents.audienceHint: With both set, only people in that department holding that title must read it. With neither, everybody must.
documents.editDocLead: Title, kind and who it applies to. The wording changes only through a new version.
documents.retireDocLead: Nobody is asked to read or sign it any more. Published versions and past signatures stay; it can be restored later.
documents.readerSearchHint: Find a person by code or name
documents.unsignedOnly: Only people who have not signed
documents.ordinalHint: Lower numbers come first in the list of papers.
documents.editTypeLead: A new validity applies to papers received from now on; papers already filed keep theirs.
documents.retireTypeLead: Nobody counts as missing it any more. Papers already filed stay on record; it can be restored later.
documents.gapSearchHint: Find a person by code or name
documents.noGapsInFilter: Nobody in this filter is missing a paper
documents.typesEmptyHere: A file can only be short of a paper, or take one in, once paper types are declared under Documents, Paper types.
documents.requiredNoneTitle: No paper type is required yet
documents.requiredNoneHint: Declare a required paper type and this list builds itself; nobody has to enter who is missing what.

assets.title: Assets
assets.lead: Where each thing is, and whose hands it went through.
assets.name: Name
assets.registerEmptyHint: Add one before it can be issued to anybody.
assets.heldEmptyHint: Issue something from stock with the button above.
assets.issueLead: The asset moves to Issued and a line goes into its hand-over history.
assets.stockEmptyHint: Add assets on the Assets page, then come back to issue.
assets.pickHint: Type a code, name or serial number
assets.takeFrom: From {name}. Note its condition on return.
assets.noMatchHint: Clear a filter, or search by asset code.
assets.editLead: Correct the name, kind, serial number or note. Who holds it changes only by issuing and taking back.
assets.exported: Exported the assets the filter shows

onboarding.noRun: No checklist opened for this person yet
onboarding.title: Joining and leaving
onboarding.lead: Unfinished work in the branch you cover, soonest due first.
onboarding.templatesLead: The most specific template wins. With none matching, starting a list fails rather than going quiet.
onboarding.templatesEmpty: No templates yet, so no list can be opened for anybody.
onboarding.templateItemsRule: Each task has an owner and a day offset from the anchor (the first day, or the last). Negative falls before it.
onboarding.noMatchHint: Clear a filter to see more tasks.
onboarding.noRunHint: Open a list from the template matching this person's job and department.
onboarding.startLead: Each task's due date counts from the anchor below.
onboarding.matchRule: A starter gets a template matching both title and department first, then one matching either, and last one with both left empty.
onboarding.templateItemsReplace: Saving replaces the whole task list. People already under way keep the list they were given.
onboarding.templateRetireLead: Nobody new is started on it. Lists already running stay as they are; it can be restored later.
onboarding.noTemplatesHint: Add an onboarding or offboarding template; from then on everyone joining or leaving gets a checklist of their own.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.lead: Who changed what, and when. Newest first.
audit.subject: Subject
audit.emptyHint: Widen the filter and try again.
audit.subjectIdHint: Search by subject id, for example 412
audit.actorHint: Type an email, code or name

users.title: Accounts
users.lead: Who can sign in, with which role, and whose record each login acts as.
users.inviteLead: A setup link goes to this address. The password is chosen by its holder and nobody else ever sees it.
users.searchHint: Search by email, code or name
users.removeWarn: Nobody ever set a password on this account, so it can go. The link already sent stops working.
users.editLead: {email}. A new role or linked record signs this account out on every device.
users.roleHint_ADMIN: Can do everything, devices, accounts and the audit log included.
users.roleHint_HR: Reads and edits records, contracts, leave and shifts company-wide.
users.roleHint_PAYROLL: Reads like HR and runs and locks payroll. Needs a linked record.
users.roleHint_MANAGER: Worked out by the system: someone with a working direct report is a Manager, and goes back to Employee when none is left. Needs a linked record.
users.roleHint_EMPLOYEE: Sees their own attendance, leave and payslips. Someone with direct reports becomes a Manager by themselves. Needs a linked record.
users.roleHint_VIEWER: Sees only their own record. The narrowest role.
users.personNeeded: The {role} role reads and decides as one person, so it needs a record.
users.personOptional: Optional for this role. Link a record so the account sees that person's own attendance, leave and payslips.
users.personMissing: Pick the employee record for this role
users.emailHint: The sign-in name, and where the password link is sent.
users.lockWarn: {name} is signed out on every device at once and cannot sign in until unlocked. Role, record and audit trail stay as they are.

leaveTypes.title: Leave types
leaveTypes.lead: What a full year of service earns in each kind, and how much of it may cross into the next year.
leaveTypes.name: Name
leaveTypes.retireLead: A retired kind stops being offered on the filing form; balances already granted keep their days.
leaveTypes.editLead: Changes apply to the next grant; balances already granted stay as they are.
leaveTypes.addLead: Each person is granted this many days for a full year of work.
leaveTypes.codeHint: Upper case; cannot be changed later.
leaveTypes.retireHint: Requests already filed with it stay as they are; you can restore it later.
leaveTypes.calendarDaysHint: For maternity leave and any type the law counts straight through; left off, only working days are charged.

doors.invited: HR opens your account and sends an invitation to your email. No invitation yet? Ask HR.

errorPage.title: This page ran into a problem

importFaults.CODE_REPEATED_IN_FILE: This code already appears on an earlier line.

catalogues.name: Name
catalogues.codeHint: Capital letters, digits, dots or dashes. It cannot change once created.

jobTitles.title: Job titles
jobTitles.lead: A job title sits on each employee record, picks the onboarding template and fills columns 7 to 11 of the D02-LT filing.
jobTitles.addLead: A new job title shows up at once in the hiring form and the onboarding templates.
jobTitles.editLead: People holding this title see the new name at once; the next filing takes the new group.
jobTitles.gradeHint: A number from 0 to 99 that orders the ladder.
jobTitles.categoryHint: The D02-LT filing marks this group in columns 8 to 11. Left empty, those four columns stay blank.
jobTitles.emptyHint: Add job titles so the hiring form has something to pick.
jobTitles.retireLead: The hiring form and onboarding templates stop offering it. {count, plural, =0 {Nobody holds it now.} one {The one person holding it keeps it.} other {The # people holding it keep it.}} You can restore it later.

legalEntities.lead: Each legal entity runs its own payroll and insurance filing. Every employee, department and pay period belongs to one.
legalEntities.addLead: A new legal entity can take departments, people and pay periods as soon as it is saved.
legalEntities.editLead: The new name and tax code apply to filings and payslips made from now on.
legalEntities.nameHint: The full name on the business registration.
legalEntities.searchHint: Search by code, name or tax code
legalEntities.retireLead: Only possible once it has no employees, no departments in use and no unpaid pay period. Past payslips and filings stay as they are.

allowances.lead: Each allowance type carries its tax, insurance and D02-LT rules. A pay record picks a type and copies those rules when it is written.
allowances.leadRead: The allowance types the pay desk keeps, with the tax and insurance rules of each.
allowances.addLead: A new type shows up at once in the pay record dialog.
allowances.editLead: The new rules apply to pay records written from now on.
allowances.editWarn: Pay records already written keep their copy of the old rules, so months already paid do not change.
allowances.taxFreeCapHint: Only the part above this is taxed. Leave empty when the whole amount follows one rule.

allowances.d02ColumnHint: Allowances in the same column are added up on the filing.
allowances.emptyHint: Add allowance types so pay records can carry allowances.
allowances.retireLead: The pay record dialog stops offering it. Pay records already written keep the allowance until the next change.
allowances.payRowsHint: Each line picks a catalogue type; the record copies that type's tax and insurance rules when it is saved.
allowances.payNoTypes: No allowance types yet. The pay desk adds them on the Allowances page.
allowances.payRowAmountInvalid: Enter a whole amount, 0 or more
